name: belisoful/prado-bayesian
description: Bayesian classification and recommendation for the PRADO PHP framework: Naive Bayes spam filtering, multinomial/Bernoulli/complement Naive Bayes, TF-IDF weighting, evaluation metrics, and a probabilistic recommender.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required by Belisoful\Prado\Util\Bayesian\Storage\TSqlBayesianStorage for SQL-backed training persistence.
suggest.ext-redis: Required by Belisoful\Prado\Util\Bayesian\Storage\TRedisBayesianStorage for Redis-backed training persistence.

scripts.lint: find src tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -d display_errors=stderr -l > /dev/null

scripts-descriptions.lint: Compile-check every PHP file under src/ and tests/ with php -l.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply php-cs-fixer to the source tree.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Check code style without changing files (what CI runs).
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level in phpstan.neon.dist.
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run the unit tests with a text and Clover coverage report.
scripts-descriptions.integration: Install the package into a throwaway consumer project and verify the extra.prado wiring.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Measure payload size, memory and load time per storage mode (see docs/storage.md).
scripts-descriptions.fulltest: The full check: lint, code style, static analysis, unit tests, in that order.
